                                                                                
 Usage: danvas assignments update [OPTIONS] SOURCE                              
                                                                                
 Plan one assignment update from Markdown; use --apply to write Canvas.         
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    source      PATH  Markdown source with assignment_id/canvas_id front    │
│                        matter, source-map entry, or --assignment-id.         │
│                        [required]                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --course-id                 INTEGER         Canvas course ID.                │
│ --assignment-id             INTEGER         Canvas assignment ID to update.  │
│ --match-title                               Resolve by exact Canvas          │
│                                             assignment title only when no ID │
│                                             is available.                    │
│ --dry-run                                   Plan without changing Canvas     │
│                                             (also the default).              │
│ --apply                                     Apply the planned change to      │
│                                             Canvas.                          │
│ --project-root              PATH            Course project root containing   │
│                                             .danvas.                         │
│                                             [default: .]                     │
│ --asset-folder              TEXT            Existing Canvas Files folder for │
│                                             local assets.                    │
│ --asset-folder-id           INTEGER         Existing Canvas Files folder ID  │
│                                             for local assets.                │
│ --asset-on-duplicate        [error|rename]  Local-asset duplicate behavior.  │
│                                             [default: error]                 │
│ --no-report                                 Suppress the default report run. │
│ --report-root               PATH            Root for a dated report run      │
│                                             directory.                       │
│ --report-dir                PATH            Exact report run directory to    │
│                                             create.                          │
│ --report-slug               TEXT            Override the report run slug.    │
│ --profile                   TEXT            User-level Canvas instance       │
│                                             profile from the danvas platform │
│                                             config.                          │
│ --api-url                   TEXT            Canvas base URL. Overrides       │
│                                             project and profile              │
│                                             configuration; CANVAS_API_URL is │
│                                             the final fallback.              │
│ --api-key-env               TEXT            Name of the environment variable │
│                                             containing the Canvas API token. │
│ --api-key-file              PATH            Absolute path to a               │
│                                             single-purpose file containing   │
│                                             the Canvas API token.            │
│ --help                                      Show this message and exit.      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
